title: At a quadratic Lebesgue point, Campanato decay identifies the centre
statement:
Let n, m, k >= 0 be natural numbers and let G : R^n -> L(R^m, R^k) be Borel measurable (continuous linear maps with the operator norm). Let z be in R^n, T in L(R^m, R^k), and A, R, alpha, s0 real with R > 0, alpha > 0, s0 > 0. Write hsNormSq(S) = sum_{i<m} ||S e_i||^2, B_t(z) for closed balls and L^n for Lebesgue measure (volume) on R^n. Assume:
(i) L^n(B_t(z))^(-1) * (lintegral over B_t(z) of ofReal(hsNormSq(G(x) - G(z))) dx) tends to 0 in [0, infinity] as t -> 0+;
(ii) for every 0 < s <= s0, the lintegral over B_{s/2}(z) of ofReal(hsNormSq(G(x) - T)) dx is <= ofReal(A s^n (s/R)^(2 alpha)).
Then G(z) = T.
lean_statement: ∀ (n m k : ℕ) (G : Rn n → (Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k)) (z : Rn n) (T : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k) (A R α s₀ : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < α → 0 < s₀ → Measurable G → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (volume (closedBall z t))⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x in closedBall z t, ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (G x - G z))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall z (s / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (G x - T)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (A * s ^ n * (s / R) ^ (2 * α))) → G z = T
